title: Favorite singers: Aretha Franklin and Stevie Wonder
summary: Gil says he was raised on pop music and names Aretha Franklin, Stevie Wonder and La Belle.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Listening to classical music, then and now

blocks.x: Oh you just look as if you're excited just thinking about it. Yes. What do you like best that you have done? Huh?
I like Brazilian music about as well as I like La Belle about as well as that. Did you see the telethon?
There was a telethon for what do you call it? Anemia.
Oh, Sickle-cell Anemia? That's right, yes, yes.

Mopsy Russel and Aretha Franklin. Aretha came on. and she's my favorite singer. Her sister, she came on first and she does more about a different kind of trouble than Aretha does. Aretha sings more the sacred part with her music and this was like the profane part, the blues, you know. Oh she's good. I've got to get her album. But I like, those are my favorite singers like Stevie Wonder. Now I'm a pop music man really basically. I was raised on pop music
and my favorite singers have always been pop singers. Because I was raised with it. We never had any concert or classical music. We never had that kind of home...
... heard Stevie Wonder's new record 'Music of My Mind'. He has turned into a very good composer.
That's what he has said he's going to do now he stopped performing.
He was there that night too.
